verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe Serverless Flex workers that 'scale to zero when idle' with pay-per-second billing (no upfront cost), contrasted with 'Active workers' that run 24/7, and CLI/API/agent-skills all support deploying serverless endpoints. This directly matches the story of deploying code to autoscaling GPU workers that scale to zero rather than always-on instances. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual scale-to-zero latency or cold-start behavior, and no third-party corroboration of serverless-specific reliability.
